On this page

The problem

Your stack already knows what went wrong. The knowledge is spread across six tools and three owners, so the decision waits while the evidence is reassembled by hand. By the time the deck is ready, the moment to act has usually passed.

The four-stage model

I work in four stages: see the whole stack in one place, answer the question behind the number, flag what needs your attention, and act inside your tools the moment you approve. Each stage feeds the next, so nothing is briefed without a source and nothing is executed without your sign-off.

What you receive

A morning brief with the three things worth your attention, each with the cause named, the projected impact quantified, and the action drafted. You approve, I execute, and the audit trail writes itself.

Why it compounds

Every decision and its outcome stays in memory. The next recommendation starts from what already worked for your organisation, not from a blank query, so the advice gets sharper every week you use it.

Pricing

Starter is $199 a month, Growth $499, Max $999, and Enterprise is custom. The launch offer takes 50% off your first two months.

FAQ

The questions every rollout asks, answered in plain language: what I connect to, how your data is isolated, and what happens the day you approve your first action.
